# dsh-freeze
> **If this helps you, please give it a star** — it helps others find it. Thanks!

Hermetic composition lock for
DeepSeek Harness (dsh).

**"Today's agent composition is byte-identical to the one you reviewed."**
Fingerprints the booted p

rofile — installed dependencies (name-sorted), the
ordered bundle composition, the pnpm lockfile has

h, the user patch layer —
baselines it, and compares on every boot. A session running on a drifted
c

omposition says so loudly; `strict: true` fails the boot entirely (the
`--frozen` posture for CI). Z
ero LLM calls in the trust path.

Family: ... mcp-test (what agents can call) · prompt-drift (what they are
told) · **freeze (what exa
ctly they are running)**.
## Why now (checked 2026-10-12)

The supply-chain lane has seven install-time scanners and one read-only
plugin ledger (`dsh-harbor`)

— all answer "is this package ok to install?"
Nobody answers **"is the composition I'm running toda

y the one that was
audited?"** Spike-verified: `dsh --dump-config` is byte-stable across runs,
and p

rofile files (package.json / pnpm-lock.yaml / cordis.patch.yml) are the
complete composition truth —
a deterministic fingerprint is sound.
## What moves the alarm
| field | meaning |

| `dependencies` | a package was added/removed/retargeted |
| `bundles` | the ordered composition ch

anged |
| `pnpm-lock` | resolved versions moved (upgrade!) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | the user layer c

| `pnpm-lock` | resolved versions moved (upgrade!) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | the user layer changed |

## Compatibility
- **DSH**: verified against the 0.2.x line (source snapshot 0.2.1-alpha.2); installs on any profile

via `dsh plugin add` (prebuilt `lib/`, no build approval).
- **Node**: >= 20 (CI matrix: Node 20/22/

24 on Ubuntu and Windows).
- **Disposable-profile evidence (2026-10-19)**: `dsh plugin --profile <fr
esh> add github:zhengqiuyang/dsh-freeze` → installed in 30s; boot shows `[dsh-freeze] active: …`; `d
sh plugin --profile <fresh> remove dsh-freeze` → dependencies cleared, bundles restored.
